incidents.name: FPR helper contracts public setAdmin
incidents.notes: The FPR helper contracts exposed setAdmin(address) to any caller, so the attacker made themselves admin and used remaining(address,address) to sweep the contracts' FPR and LP holdings.

sources.ref: onchain review: helper 0x81c5664be54d89E725ef155F14cf34e6213297B7 created 2022-12-14T07:59:22Z by 0x2d71adecb7a4f75f7fb21816a980cac307d276d9, unrelated to attack sender 0xe3104e645bc3f6fd821930a6a39ee509a0e87d3b; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Four identical helper contracts were drained (0x81c5664b..., 0xE2f0A9B6..., 0x39eb555f..., 0xBa5B235C...); the first is recorded as the victim. Loss verified onchain: 26,274.80 USDT left the FPR/USDT pair 0x039D05a19e3436c536bE5c814aaa70FcdbDde58b to the attacker in this transaction.
